US Considers Diesel Export Curbs, Not a Ban, Energy Secretary Says

The U.S. is considering restrictions on diesel exports, not an outright ban, according to Energy Secretary Jennifer Granholm. The White House has denied reports suggesting a ban was being considered. This situation has reportedly strained ties between the Republican party and the oil industry.
